title: Crackline Uganda
author: unknown
contents: A campaign in the likes of Half-Life's infamous mod "Crack-Life". It comes with a single level, that tells the player to play the vanilla game of HLM2 with the mods installed. What's the worst thing that could happen?

title: Epistle 1
author: Plank
contents: Part of the infamous "Coomtaker" saga, which hasn't been uploaded to the Steam Workshop, but instead on The Workshop Labs' Discord server, since its ending crashes the game no matter which way you go.

title: 2k Act 1
author: Janja
contents: A single level by janja, starring Evan who invades an office complex of some sort.

A noticable feature of this level is the rather cryptic dialogue being l33t-speak Russian (don't know how else to describe it). That and an amazing animation of a car crashing into the building similar to the second boss of the original Hotline Miami.

title: Chopped
author: Janja
contents: A single level starring Richter, clearing out a subway station.
One noticable moment is the floor with the train moving in, as well as the small puzzle to open the gate.

title: Fatal Drive
author: Janja
contents: A single level starring a Spider masked vigilante, breaking out of a police station similar to Hotline Miami 2's "Final Cut", including a cute choreography to end the level.

title: Hard Trip
author: Janja
contents: Single level starring Jacket clearing out a subway station, featuring a floor inside of a moving train.

title: 2k Act 1 Part 2
author: Janja
contents: A single level heavily inspired by Hotline Miami 2's "No Mercy", starring Corey.

title: 2k Act 2 (Eng)
author: Janja
contents: A 5-level long campaign about "Sanja", a prisoner and the warden "Sergei", trying to get a hold of their life during the many riots of the facilty. We hope you like psycho prisoners.
Judging by the grammar of this campaign, it was originally in Russian and then roughly translated to English. It's a bit of a hard read, but it should be understandable with enough effort.

It's possible, that the last level's last cutscene bugs out and sends you back to the first floor instead of sending you to the score screen. Should that happen to you, we provided the outro of the last level as a compromise so that you don't have to replay the level all over again.

title: Cleaning
author: Janja
contents: A 1-level campaign where the fans plan their next raid into a headquaters full of Russian mobsters. A nice level with the player chararcter switching to one of the fans every 2 floors (excluding Mark) and a very pretty layout.
The intro is in Russian. If you want to see the actual text appearing, then change the game's language to Russian.

title: Dead Calls 2
author: Janja
contents: A 6-level campaign, which is a compilation of Martin, Corey and Richter levels with an easy to follow plot for each character, including a refined version of "2k Act 1 Part 2".
The plot is in Russian. If you want to see the actual text appearing, then change the game's language to Russian.

title: Deadly Trick
author: Janja
contents: A 1-level campaign about a SWAT team storming a mansion, that has a ticking bomb deep inside. Apart from the visually stunning intro, the main attraction of this level is the bomb being an actual threat throughout the level, that will blow up the whole floor if you're not fast enough. Can you make it to the last floor and defuse the bomb in time?
To see the full dialogue, set the game's language to Russian so that the lines won't go over the screen.

title: Hot Arrival
author: Janja
contents: A 1-level campaign about the Son invading a Colombian hideout, similar to "Death Wish" from the main game, changing the playable character from the Henchman, Sasha (Pardo reskin) and the Son himself.

title: Deep Red Redux
author: SuitedFox
contents: SuitedFox's infamous campaign, starring Jake Coalis, who's trying to get his revenge on those who tried to murder him.

title: Workshop War
author: SuitedFox
contents: Another one of Suitedfox's infamous entries, in which Jake Coalis, the protagonist of Deep Red: Redux tries to get his revenge on those, who ridiculed Suitedfox and his behaviour within the modding community.
